question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

The widespread __________ (destruction) of the natural world threatens the food we eat, the water we drink and the air we breathe.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"destruction"** means the action or process of causing so much damage to something that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired. (विनाश)

 
 
• **Example:** The hurricane caused widespread **destruction **in the coastal areas.
 
 
 
• **"Creation"** refers to the action or process of bringing something into existence. (सृजन)
 
 
• **Example:** The **creation **of the new park has added a beautiful green space to the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'destruction'** is **'creation'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Condition** (स्थिति): The state of something with regard to its appearance, quality, or working order.

 
 
• **Example:** The **condition **of the old house was deteriorating rapidly.
 
 
 
• **Choice** (विकल्प): An act of selecting or making a decision when faced with two or more possibilities.
 
 
• **Example:** She had to make a difficult **choice **between her career and her family.
 
 
 
• **Contribution** (योगदान): A gift or payment to a common fund or collection.
 
 
• **Example:** His **contribution **to the charity was greatly appreciated.
